facts.fact: The TTCL data centre at Kijitonyama, Dar es Salaam, described as Tanzania's largest, was operating and offering services to both public and commercial organisations, though barely occupied; operated by Tanzania Telecommunication Company Limited (TTCL). Article gives no opening date, so as_of is its published date. It is described as built to Tier Three specifications, with no certification or operator statement.

note: Tier III only as built-to-specification per DCD, so no tier3 fact.
